message: The other day, we had a storm rolling in, and I found myself rummaging through the attic for flashlights and candles. While I was up there, I stumbled upon an old board game from the '80s. You know, the kind with the colorful pieces and no screens in sight? We dusted it off and played for hours while the wind howled outside. It reminded me that sometimes, the best way to weather a storm is to unplug and enjoy a little low-tech fun with family. What’s your favorite way to pass the time when the weather keeps you in?
